headline: XP Downgrades Brazilian Stock Market to Neutral on Fiscal Concerns
summary: XP downgraded its recommendation on the Brazilian stock market from buy to neutral, citing fiscal concerns following President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's re-election and expectations of high interest rates.
why: XP is one of Brazil's largest investment platforms, and its asset allocation downgrades can influence domestic institutional and retail investor flows.
why_moved: Concerns over fiscal policy and prolonged high interest rates led to a cautious stance on local equities.
